pull_request.title: Calorimeter: publish executive summary of hardware programme
pull_request.head: codex/calorimeter-executive-summary
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

ODD already describes the calorimeter sampling layers and logical cells. To make nODD as physically explicit as its tracker, we need to describe the hardware that holds, cools, powers and reads out those layers. The maintained nODD assembly currently contains the beam pipe and tracker; a complete calorimeter hardware baseline is still to be established.

The largest gaps are physical sensor/tile modules and cassettes, load-bearing supports, cooling circuits, electronics and power distribution, service routes, and their interfaces to the new inner solenoid. The inherited copper-rich HCAL PCB mixture also needs a hardware/material justification. Cryostat requirements depend on the chosen technology: silicon/scintillator calorimeters need an operating and cooling design, while the superconducting solenoid needs an explicit cryogenic vessel and service system.

The proposed sequence is to agree the technology, operating conditions, material ledger and shared interfaces; design one realistic ECAL cassette and one HCAL cassette; then build sectors and complete barrel/endcap assemblies with reproducible geometry, mass and material checks. This PR supplies the assessment and that staged plan. Calorimeter response, reconstruction, jets and particle flow follow as a separate programme.

## Follow-up to merged PR #65

[PR #65](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/65) merged as `26258c9`. The user requested a fresh push after that merge. This PR makes the executive summary part of the versioned DES-027 document and reconciles PR65's actual head/merge metadata. It retains the detailed assessment and its source/numerical evidence.

DES-027 remains DRAFT; merging its assessment does not select hardware or confer engineering sign-off. This is an editorial follow-up without detector or dependency changes.
